title: Creamed Corn Chowder Pilaf
ingredients: 1 litre (1.75 pints) hot vegetable stock, plus extra if needed
SPICE MIX: 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp dried thyme, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp pepper, 1/2 tsp onion granules, 1/2 tsp garlic granules
method: Mix together all the ingredients for the spice mix.

Using a sauté pan (with a lid), melt the butter and fry the onion for 5 minutes until soft. Add the garlic, sweetcorn and spice mix, stir together, then pour in about half the hot stock and all the milk. Bring up to a simmer and simmer for 5 minutes.
Using a ladle, remove 2 ladlefuls of the mixture and place in a bowl. Purée it with a hand blender or mini chopper, then return it to the sauté pan.
Add the rice and remaining stock to the pan, stir it through and place the lid on. Simmer gently for 15 minutes. Remove the lid, stir, then allow it to bubble for 5 minutes with the lid off.
Check that the rice is cooked (if not, allow to simmer for longer). Stir through the cream cheese. Season with black pepper and serve scattered with finely chopped parsley.
notes: Can be eaten as a stand-alone meal or as a great side dish to grilled or barbecued meats. For non-vegetarians, fry chopped smoked bacon or chorizo with the onion in step 2.
